newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC seen holding January grain estimates stable.
newsitem.headline: ONIC seen holding January grain estimates stable.

text.p: France's ONIC cereals office is expected to roll forward its previous grain estimates when it issues new monthly projections this week, grain industry sources said on Monday.
ONIC will issue the January edition of its monthly French supply/demand report for French grains on Wednesday at 1100 GMT.
The absence of new figures is due to the traditional two-week shutdown of French grain markets over the New Year, when ONIC's routine monthly planning meeting was not held.
The sources said, however they did not rule out minor technical adjustments to the grain forecasts last published in December.
In that report, ONIC pencilled in a 1996 soft wheat crop of 34.586 million tonnes, with French exports to non-EU countries between July 1, 1996, and June 30, 1997, of six million tonnes.
These figures were up sharply from a 1995 crop of 29.825 million tonnes and 1995/96 exports of 3.75 million tonnes.
